thread:
sam (marketing): Quick sync — we need final assets for the release post tomorrow. Items: changelog commit link, docs deep-link, short benchmark blurb for header, webinar time, and inbound lead mapping. Who can confirm?
devin (eng): I can provide the changelog commit shortly. Will also paste perf numbers from the last canary run. No infra changes expected.
kai (docs): I’ll add a docs anchor at /docs/serve/dedicated#release-quickstart and a short note about rollout flags. ETA 3pm PT.
marisol (product): Reminder: avoid absolute language. Use "up to" and include measurement caveats. Also include fallback behavior in the longer blog copy.
ilesha-sales: For lead routing: demo requests -> queue-demo, enterprise -> ae-inbox. Need the form field name to wire CRM filters.
sam (marketing): Use form field name "est_annual_rev" and tag "release-q2-2026". Draft headline: "Up to 1.6x throughput for sustained chat; p95 typically <200ms (measured on 512-token set)." Thoughts?
marisol (product): Slightly conservative: change to "up to 1.5x" and "p95 typically under 200ms". Add parenthetical "(512-token eval; workload-dependent)".
devin (eng): Canary figures: p50=90ms, p95=170ms on 512-token samples, sustained throughput ~1100 tok/s with batching on an A10G-equivalent. I'll put these into the changelog PR.
kai (docs): Docs link ready: https://docs.redwood.ai/serve/dedicated#release-quickstart. I added an API example and a short list of flags.
sam (marketing): Can you post the changelog commit when the PR merges? Need the permalink for the blog and the social thread. Also want a one-paragraph benchmark narrative for slides.
devin (eng): Draft bench paragraph: "On sustained long-chat workloads (512 tokens), our dedicated config shows median latency ~90ms and p95 ~170ms while delivering up to 1.5x throughput vs baseline open checkpoints, thanks to continuous batching and KV cache. Results vary by prompt and model." Good?
sam (marketing): That's perfect. Short headline for tweet: "Up to 1.5x throughput on long-chat; p95 typically under 200ms (512-token eval)." Will expand in blog.
marisol (product): Add: "graceful fallback to smaller variants during high contention" in the longer blurb so customers know reliability story.
devin (eng): Added fallback note to the changelog entry and docs. Feature flag for early access: "dedicated_preview_2026" expires 2026-06-05. No admin API breaking changes.
ilesha-sales: Webinar dates available: May 22 10am PT, May 23 11am PT, May 28 9am PT. Prefer May 22. Please confirm registrant tag 'release-q2-2026'.
sam (marketing): Locking May 22 10am PT. Ops: please reserve Zoom slot and calendar. I'll create registration with tag 'release-q2-2026' and field est_annual_rev.
deploy-bot: scheduled deployment window: 2026-05-22T17:00Z -> 2026-05-22T18:00Z (canary to global over 45m). Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/release-2026-05-22
sam (marketing): Nice — we'll run webinar morning, announce post after deploy-bot marks global. Final asks: eng drop changelog commit link here; docs confirm link persistence post-merge; product sign-off on copy by EOD.
devin (eng): Changelog PR merged. Commit permalink: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/a9b4c6d. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/415
kai (docs): Docs link is stable after merge.
marisol (product): Approved copy with the tweaks.
sam (marketing): Drafting announcement thread now. Will queue social and blog, then ping for 1-click approvals. Thanks all :tada:
